Assuming \(\log(x)\) is the natural logarithm, use integration by parts:

Let  
\(u = \log(x)\), so \(du = 1/x \, dx\)  
and \(dv = dx\), so \(v = x\).

Then

\[
\int \log(x)\,dx
= x * \log(x) - \int x * 1/x \, dx
\]

\[
= x * \log(x) - \int 1 \, dx
\]

\[
= x * \log(x) - x + C
\]

<answer>x * log(x) - x + C</answer>
